skill_name: Develop a website for a travel blog
workflow: A website for a travel blog should be easy to navigate and highly interactive. It should feature a variety of sections, such as stories, photos, and videos. Additionally, a good website should have engaging industry-specific content, including travel itineraries and recommendations, as well as travel tips and advice. Other important features might include a blog newsletter, a live chat feature, and an online store. The website design should be aesthetically pleasing and consistent with the brand
